items.name: Eugene Spring 2018

venue.name: [Sheldon Community Center](https://www.eugene-or.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Sheldon-Community-Center-20)
venue.details: First door on your left when you walk in the building

items.information: There is a $14 registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. On March 13th, this fee will increase to $24. Your registration will not be confirmed (moved from the waiting list) until payment has been completed. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. There is a 90 competitor limit to the competition. Please register as soon as possible if you plan on coming! Registration closes at the end of the day on March 24th. We will grant refunds to those who let us know by March 24th, but no refunds are granted after that date.

items.name: Hyderabad Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Hira Hall - Sree Sindhi Guru Sangat Sabha
venue.address: 4-1-1106, YWCA Road, Bogulkunta, Hyderguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001, India

items.information: Participants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 31st March 2018 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 29th March 2018 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 29th March 2018 9:00pm IST. Please note once you register in WCA site for the Hyderabad Cube Open 2018, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation. Additional information will be provided in the tabs.

items.information: Please check the competition website for more information like schedules, fees, etc. The meaning of the competition name is obvious. Only 3x3x3 fewest moves and 3x3x3 multi-blindfolded are allowed to use more than one cube.

venue.name: Webb University Center, Old Dominion University

items.information: Registration fee: $20 per competitor. **No refunds!** Registration must be paid online. There is no at-the-door registration. There will be a competitor limit of 125. All net proceeds will go to Engineers Without Borders, a group of engineers who benefit underserved communities.

items.name: Royal Corner Twist 2018
items.information: The venue is a hotel which sponsors part of the competition cost. There is also a price discount for living on the hotel. There's an registration fee of 150 SEK. The registration will be done through this website. The competition is open for both competitors and spectators but there is a limit of 150 people in the venue at the same time. For more information visit the [website](royalcornertwist.com).

items.name: Rutgers Spring 2018

venue.name: [Rutgers University](https://www.rutgers.edu/)
venue.address: 84 Joyce Kilmer Ave, Piscataway Township, NJ 08854

items.information: This competition will serve as a fundraiser for the Rutgers Chapter of Alpha Kappa Psi, the Co-Ed Professional Business Fraternity. Funds will go toward the Rutgers Dance Marathon – an event that aims to raise money for the Embrace Kids Foundation that benefits families and children affected by cancer, sickle cell, and other diseases. There is a flat fee of $25 and a competitor limit of 200. Refunds will not be granted and walk-in competitors will not be permitted, no exceptions.
